symptom: DESCRIBE drops `DataSource: selection X` for a DataView bound to a gallery/listview selection (master-detail pages)
cause: `extractDataViewDataSource` only handled `Forms$MicroflowSource` / `Forms$NanoflowSource` / `Forms$DataViewSource` / `Forms$DatabaseSource`; `Forms$ListenTargetSource` fell through to `return nil`
insight: Add `case "Forms$ListenTargetSource":` returning `{Type: "selection", Reference: ds["ListenTarget"]}`; add `case "selection":` in the DataView output switch emitting `DataSource: selection <ref>`
